proof_boundary.not_proved: The transported second isotropic basis vector need not be the equation-effective zero marking, and this regression does not enumerate new relative U embeddings or construct equations.
proof_boundary.proved: For all 42 stored ordered U-pairs, exact integral projection gives G_A=A^T J A-J; saturating the projected pair recovers the stored rank-two bridge on both orientations, with the determinant corrected by the square of the recorded saturation index. The (1,1) entry of A recovers every stored old-fibre degree.
